translation.name: No Sigar Kunubus tika ma Ira Ninge na Lotu

content.text: Iakano huntunaan mon tane Iakop diet ga hansur huo meras ta ira matanaiabar a mes ira udiet nianga.
Io, Iudeia ga hanuat no halhaliana taman ta God,
ma i la harkurai taar kaia Israel.
No Dardarana Tes ga nanaas ma ga hilau laah,
ma no Taah Ioridaan ga saal tapukus.
Ira tamat na uladih diet ga karkaruas ho ira tumatena sipsip,
ma ira nat na uladih hoing ra nat na sipsip.
Dardarana Tes, warah bih gu hilau laah?
Taah Ioridaan, u saal tapukus warah mah?
Muat ira tamat na uladih, warah bih muat karkaruas ho ira tumatena sipsip,
ma muat ira nat na uladih, ho ira nat na sipsip?
Augu no ula hanuo, dedar ra matmataan tano Watong,
kaia tano matmataan tano God tane Iakop,
aie nong ga kios no haat bia na hanuat pup na taah,
ma no malaapar mah bia na hanuat taah i la pupuat.
